description_en: Retrieves the OSS pre-signed upload URL and object name required for importing an AgentSpec ZIP package. After the upload is complete, call the AgentSpec OSS upload operation to complete the import
description_zh: 获取导入 AgentSpec ZIP 包所需的 OSS 预签名上传地址和对象名称。上传完成后，可调用 AgentSpec OSS 上传接口完成导入
name: GetAgentSpecImportFileUrl

parameters.help_en: The Content-Type of the file to upload. The client must use the same value from the response when performing the PUT request
parameters.help_zh: 上传文件 Content-Type，客户端 PUT 时必须使用响应中的同一值
parameters.name: content_type
